headline.text: Two prediction-market prices look off by more than the fee; about $90 a month if they hold, paper only.

items.title: Rate decision market
items.detail: Market says 62%, the public futures curve implies about 71%. Edge after fee is thin.

items.title: Weather high-temperature market
items.detail: Forecast agreement is strong; market price lags by 5 points.

items.title: Earnings beat market
items.detail: Close to fair; skip unless the price moves.
